source_evidence: Day328~11:53 exact player 'I like it. Lets make a deal' expresses willingness to negotiate a prospective partnership following the obligations review. It does not authorize paying the proposed250gp, signing an agreement, granting access to estates or accepting unagreed liabilities. Harthvale voluntarily proposes concrete nonbinding negotiating terms:250gp capital contribution due only upon final agreement and assent of the three existing trading households; one vote alongside the three member households on association decisions and one-quarter of future distributable profits after actual operating costs, reserves agreed by members and existing obligations; separate negotiated commercial charges and capacity for any use of V's facilities; no personal assumption of existing association debts and no transfer of title or public river authority. The vote and proposed profit share are newly offered terms, not established historical ownership or an agreed valuation. Harthvale says he will put the proposed terms to Dunmere, Rellwick and Branthor, but their assent has not been sought or obtained in play. Sornell asks that his promised departure settlement be included among existing obligations and Harthvale agrees it must be addressed in the final terms; amount/timing remain unverified. Cirren independently requests a private word with V before any agreement is made, consistent with prior advice from Desen to avoid further commitments/payments. Harthvale permits the party a moment to confer privately; no departure from building, actual private discussion, new admission, signing, payment, further records access, note-taking or binding agreement assumed. No roll for willing prospective offer; V chooses whether to confer, counteroffer, or take another action. Desen not yet informed of today's developments.
